OPENING — Before the first student even sits down, this slide is on screen. Music playing if possible (something like Avengers theme works great).
As students settle in, walk to the front WITHOUT saying anything for 10 seconds. Let the silence build. Then:
SAY: "Haath uthao — how many of you have seen a magic show?" (pause for hands) SAY: "Good. Now keep your hand up if you think magic is REAL." (pause) SAY: "I'm going to show you something more real than magic. It's called AI — and in the next 3 hours, YOU will have its superpower."
TIMING: Spend 60-90 seconds on this slide. Let the energy build. Don't rush. The title slide sets the entire emotional tone of the day.
TIPS: Make eye contact with the back row. Speak slowly and confidently. If students are already buzzing, that's perfect — you've already won.
